SELECT t.ID, t.FACTORY_CODE, t.YEAR, t.MONTH, t.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, t.PRODUCTION_VERSION, t.PLAN_TYPE, t.DATA_SOURCE, t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.STRUCTURE_NAME, t.IS_HAS_SPECIAL_MATERIAL, t.MAX_EMBRYO_CODE_COUNT, t.MAX_LH_MACHINE_COUNT, t.MIN_LH_MACHINE_COUNT, t.NET_QTY, t.LOSS_QTY, t.BEGIN_DAY, t.END_DAY, t.ALLOT_DAYS, mm.CX_MACHINE_TYPE_CODE, 1 data_type FROM T_MP_STRUCTURE_ALLOCATION t LEFT JOIN t_mdm_molding_machine mm ON t.CX_MACHINE_CODE = mm.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND mm.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE t.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND t.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} AND t.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion} AND t.YEAR = #{year} AND t.MONTH = #{month} AND t.IS_DELETE = 0
AND t.CX_MACHINE_CODE LIKE concat('%', #{cxMachineCode}, '%')
GROUP BY t.STRUCTURE_NAME ORDER BY t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.BEGIN_DAY
